issues.title: Incorrect tauri version in metadata file
issues.description: The metadata-v2.json file specifies tauri version as "2.8.2" but the actual tauri crate version is "2.8.3" as shown in crates/tauri/Cargo.toml. This version mismatch will cause the CLI to report incorrect version information to tools and scripts that depend on this metadata. The PR updated the tauri version to 2.8.3, but the metadata file was not updated accordingly, creating an inconsistency between the actual library version and the advertised version.

issues.title: Dependency version mismatch for tauri-bundler
issues.description: The tauri-cli Cargo.toml declares a dependency on tauri-bundler version "2.6.0", but the actual tauri-bundler crate version is "2.6.1" as specified in crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml. This creates a version constraint mismatch that could cause build failures or prevent the CLI from using the updated bundler with the bug fix for 32-bit Windows builds. The CHANGELOG indicates this version should have been updated to 2.6.1 to pick up the binary patching fix.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14070 - Apply Version Updates From Current Changes
pr.author: unknown

structured_output.summary:
This is an automated release PR produced by covector for the changes merged since the last release: `tauri` 2.8.3 (WebView2 FixedRuntime detection fix), `tauri-bundler` 2.6.1 (32-bit Windows binary patching fix), `tauri-cli` 2.8.1, and `@tauri-apps/cli` 2.8.2. It deletes the two consumed change files and updates the crate/npm manifests, CHANGELOGs, `Cargo.lock`, `metadata-v2.json`, and both copies of the config schema.

The generated output is mostly correct, but hand edits on top of the generated commit break release consistency. `metadata-v2.json`'s `tauri` version is left at 2.8.2 while the committed schema `$id` is 2.8.3 — the schema is derived from that field, so the repo's `check generated files` workflow will regenerate 2.8.2 and fail. `tauri-cli`'s `tauri-bundler` requirement is also reverted to 2.6.0 even though the changelog announces 2.6.1, and an unrelated `homepage` field was added to `tauri-bundler`. These should be fixed before merge.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The version bumps themselves are correct, but the head state cannot pass the repo's `check generated files` workflow: the committed config schema `$id` (2.8.3) is derived from `metadata-v2.json`, which still says `tauri: 2.8.2`, so a fresh schema build produces a diff. The PR also ships a `tauri-cli` manifest that does not require the `tauri-bundler` 2.6.1 version its own changelog announces.

architecture.overview:
Tauri releases are driven by covector: change files under `.changes/` declare per-package bump types, and `.changes/config.json` maps each package to its manifest, dependencies, and `postversion` hooks. The versioning run bumps package versions in `Cargo.toml`/`package.json`, refreshes `Cargo.lock`, prepends CHANGELOG sections, deletes consumed change files, and then executes the hooks. For the `tauri` crate the hook updates `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json` and rebuilds `crates/tauri-schema-generator`, whose `build.rs` derives the config schema `$id` from the metadata's `tauri` field. This PR is that generated output for `tauri` 2.8.3, `tauri-bundler` 2.6.1, `tauri-cli` 2.8.1, and `@tauri-apps/cli` 2.8.2.

The CLI package additionally keeps a versioned dependency on `tauri-bundler` (`version = "2.6.x"` plus a path), which covector updates in the same run. A CI workflow (`check-generated-files.yml`) re-runs the schema generator and fails if the committed schemas differ, making `metadata-v2.json` the source of truth for the published schema `$id` as well as for versions injected by `tauri init`/`tauri plugin init`.
steps: `.changes/binary-patching-32-bit.md` and `.changes/fix-webview2-path-timing.md` declare patch bumps for `tauri-bundler` and `tauri`; covector consumes and deletes them.

The version step writes the new versions into `crates/tauri/Cargo.toml`, `crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml`, `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml`, `packages/cli/package.json`, the CHANGELOGs, and `Cargo.lock`.
`postversion` hooks run `sync-cli-metadata.js`, which bumps the `tauri` and `cli.js` entries in `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`.

The `tauri` hook then runs `cargo build` on `crates/tauri-schema-generator`; `build.rs` reads `metadata-v2.json` and writes `https://schema.tauri.app/config/{tauri_version}` into both `config.schema.json` copies.
Covector also bumps `tauri-cli`'s versioned `tauri-bundler` dependency so the published CLI requires the bundler release it was tested against.
CI's `check-generated-files` job reruns the schema generator after any schema/manifest change and fails on a non-empty `git diff`; this is where the stale `metadata-v2.json` becomes visible.

findings.title: Release metadata leaves `tauri` at 2.8.2 while crate and schemas move to 2.8.3
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json` line 6, the `tauri` field is still `2.8.2` while this release bumps the `tauri` crate to 2.8.3 and commits config schemas whose `$id` is `https://schema.tauri.app/config/2.8.3`. Change the field to `"2.8.3"`. Do not hand-edit the schema files: `crates/tauri-schema-generator/build.rs` derives their `$id` from this field. Verify by running `cargo build --manifest-path ./crates/tauri-schema-generator/Cargo.toml` and confirming `git diff --name-only` is empty afterward.

findings.title: tauri-cli dependency on tauri-bundler is still 2.6.0 despite changelog claiming 2.6.1
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml` line 50, the `tauri-bundler` dependency still says `version = "2.6.0"`, but this release bumps tauri-bundler to 2.6.1 and `crates/tauri-cli/CHANGELOG.md` claims `Upgraded to tauri-bundler@2.6.1`. Restore `version = "2.6.1"` while keeping `default-features = false` and the path. This must match what covector generates for the dependency declared under `tauri-cli` in `.changes/config.json`; do not change the CHANGELOG text instead.

findings.title: Unrelated `homepage` field added to tauri-bundler manifest
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml` line 12, `homepage = "https://tauri.app/"` was added manually but is unrelated to this generated version-update PR. Remove it from this branch, or move it to a separate PR. Keep the release PR limited to covector output so the generated changes stay reviewable.

findings.title: Generated version bumps and lockfile churn are otherwise consistent
findings.body:
The generated parts of the release line up: `tauri` 2.8.3 (`crates/tauri/Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, CHANGELOG), `tauri-bundler` 2.6.1, `tauri-cli` 2.8.1, and `@tauri-apps/cli` 2.8.2 all match their CHANGELOG sections, and the two consumed `.changes/*.md` files are removed correctly.

The `Cargo.lock` edge updates for `colored`/`winapi-util` (windows-sys 0.59.0) and `libloading` (windows-targets 0.52.6) have no matching manifest change, but they are legitimate: those already-pinned crate versions declare ranges (`>=0.48, <=0.59` and `>=0.48, <0.53`), so regenerating the lockfile selects the newer maximum. No action needed.
